rationale: The report uses numbered sections, sustained passive voice, and formally assigns fault to 'normal end-of-life wear' of the compressor, honoring its years of service.
quote: The failure was determined to be due to normal end-of-life wear on the compressor unit after approximately 9 years of continuous operation, including multiple Stanley Cup runs, March Madness, and two fantasy football seasons. No maintenance oversights, misuse, or procedural violations were identified. Nobody is at fault.
